registration_timing: after the sealed terminal R16/R32/R64 outcomes and before any nonterminal R32/R64 kappa trajectory outcome
claim_scope: mechanism mapping of visit alignment and optimization stress over training in the frozen small-scale two-linear residual-loop family; no task-performance, sample-efficiency, general Transformer, or general stability claim
prior_knowledge_boundary: The R16/R32/R64 terminal outcomes and terminal gradient maxima are known. Terminal cells are replication checks, not new confirmation. The nonterminal R32/R64 trajectories and all interval-gradient summaries are untouched endpoints.

frozen_training.chunk_strategy: one rounds-by-regime-by-seed cell at a time

co_primary_endpoints.alignment_surface: per-seed kappa at every rounds-by-regime-by-exposure cell, summarized by a geometric mean
co_primary_endpoints.optimization_stress: per-cell and per-interval maximum, root-mean-square, and terminal parameter-gradient norm, with loss endpoints and nonfinite status

candidate_models.fit_method: deterministic ordinary least squares on the 15 tied geometric-mean cells

comparison.winner_rule: best model must beat the runner-up by at least 4 AICc units and have no more than 0.9 times the runner-up blocked-CV RMSE; otherwise unresolved

depth_curvature.onset_rule: first exposure in [512,1024,2048] where point C(E)<=-0.2 and the 95% seed-bootstrap upper bound is below -0.1
depth_curvature.terminal_role: E4096 is reported and used for surface fitting but excluded from first-onset confirmation because its direction was known before registration

gradient_coupling.stress_ratio: geometric-mean tied interval maximum gradient divided by the matched untied geometric mean
gradient_coupling.co_localization_rule: at the registered curvature-onset interval, the R64 stress ratio is at least 5 and exceeds the corresponding R16 and R32 ratios
gradient_coupling.association_diagnostic: Spearman correlation across all depth-by-interval cells between negative delta log(kappa) and log(stress_ratio); diagnostic only

terminal_replication.source: sealed v0.1 and saturation-addendum terminal records
terminal_replication.pass_rule: every new terminal per-seed kappa must differ from its sealed predecessor by at most 0.02 in absolute log ratio
terminal_replication.on_failure: classify instrument_drift and do not issue a trajectory-mechanism claim

untied_control.pass_rule: the point depth gamma is within the equivalence region at terminal exposure and at least four of five exposures
untied_control.interpretation: a failed control is retained and prevents a tied-specific mechanism claim

classification.depth_training_transition: r64_change_point wins, a preterminal curvature onset is detected, gradient co-localization passes, terminal replication passes, and the untied control passes
classification.geometric_transition_without_gradient_su: r64_change_point wins and preterminal curvature onset is detected, but gradient co-localization fails
classification.smooth_learning: separable or smooth_interaction wins, no preterminal curvature onset is detected, and both integrity controls pass
classification.control_failure: terminal replication passes but the untied control fails
classification.form_unresolved: none of the above branches is licensed

stop_branches.on_nonfinite_training: stop the affected cell, retain its complete prior trace, and classify resource_or_training_failure rather than geometric evidence
stop_branches.on_estimator_instability: stop the affected regime and retain raw traces
stop_branches.on_resource_failure: seal the resource failure and do not reinterpret it as a depth transition
stop_branches.on_existing_output: refuse to overwrite any trajectory records or result receipt

claim_boundary: This registered follow-up can identify when a depth-specific alignment deviation and optimization stress co-occur in one small residual-loop construction. It cannot establish causality between gradients and alignment, and it cannot generalize the transition to Transformers or task performance.

resources.foreign_gpu_process_policy: observe and abort before launch; never terminate foreign processes
